create_publisher_method: create a Labgraph Node method decorated with @publisher to publish messages to a Topic
create_subscriber_method: create a Labgraph Node method decorated with @subscriber to receive messages from a Topic
create_transformer_method: create a Labgraph Node method decorated with both @publisher and @subscriber to transform messages
create_background_method: create a Labgraph Node method decorated with @background to run in a background event loop
create_main_method: create a Labgraph Node method decorated with @main to run in the main thread on startup
